youtube_description:
Dear Brothers, 

Are you concerned, uncertain or angry over what is going on in the Catholic Church? 

Do you know the facts?

Are you aware of steps faithful Catholics like you must do to stem this tsunami of evil?

Come to our 2019 North Texas Catholic Men's Conference on February 23rd at St. Patrick Church in Dallas to learn the truth. Our theme this year is "Renew Your Faith." 

Discover what you must do immediately to help save our faith and protect our church and the members of the Body of Christ from the supernatural forces "seeking the ruin of souls."

Our speakers will be Dallas Bishop Edward Burns, Father Mitch Pacwa, who appears regularly on EWTN and Patrick Coffin, former host of the Catholic Answers radio show and now chief theologian at The Patrick Coffin show.

Our fall and spring men's conferences are created and hosted by The North Texas Catholic Brothers For Christ non-profit organization. We are a band of Catholic brothers from different  parishes throughout North Texas who are committed to strengthening and building Christ’s body.

Our Vision: All Catholic men committed to building the body of Christ.

Our Mission: To motivate all Catholic men to commit to building the body of Christ by uniting as brothers, witnessing the gospel in all areas of our lives, and facilitating faith-building programs in our community.


Your Brothers in Christ,

Rick Self, CBFC non-profit President
Bob Duane, 2019 Conference Lead

2019 Speakers Bishop Burns, Father Pacwa and Patrick Coffin
